events.title: Norsk Hydro ASA (NHYDY) Q1 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Navigating Challenges with Strong ...
events.body: Despite a decline in revenue and negative free cash flow, Norsk Hydro ASA (NHYDY) reports robust aluminum production and strategic advancements in renewable energy.

events.title: Norsk Hydro’s Qatar Aluminum Plant Won’t Shut Down Fully as Partner Renews Gas Flow
events.body: The Qatalum plant, an equally owned joint venture with a subsidiary of state-controlled QatarEnergy, will maintain aluminum output at around 60% of total capacity.
